title: sensor issues
symptom: The Libre sensor displays 'lo' even with a normal NFC scan, while a blood glucose test shows around 10. The sensor has just under 4 days left of use but the user thinks they will have to change it.
cause: The sensor may have moved a bit and stopped measuring, possibly due to the arm holder or strap used with the Blucon.
fix: Replace the sensor. Ensure the skin is clean and consider fixing the sensor with transparent adhesive (e.g., Fixomull Stretch or Tegaderm) to prevent movement.
evidence_quote: I assume your Sensor moved a bit and doesn't measure anything anymore. you should replace it. make sure your property clean the skin and if it Happens again you should consider fixing the Sensor with kind of transparent adhesive.
